slides.title: The Connector.
slides.body: Knows everyone and is always in the middle of something. Every plan passes through them sooner or later.

slides.title: The Foodie.
slides.body: Loud, loved and always hungry. Has never left on time, because there was one more plate.

slides.title: The Organiser.
slides.body: Connects three groups of friends who would never have met. Has a group for every occasion and a poll for every group.

slides.title: The Aesthetic One.
slides.body: Has a plant, a favourite cafe and a very good camera roll. Everything looks better after they photograph it.

slides.title: The Serious One.
slides.body: Always in formal clothes, always between meetings, replies with “noted”. Surprisingly good fun once it is Friday.

slides.title: The Last Stop.
slides.body: Lives the furthest away and says “I’ll try to make it” every time. Turns up eventually, and stays the longest.
